doc.description: Forwards RTCM3 corrections from an NTRIP caster or from a mixed UBX/RTCM serial input to the aircraft over Ivy.
doc.usage: usage: ntrip2ivy.py [-h] [-m MOUNTPOINT] [--url URL] [--username USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [-d RTK_BASE] [-b RTK_BASE_BAUDRATE] [--no-ivy] [--bus BUS] [--serial-output SERIAL_OUTPUT] [--serial-output-baudrate SERIAL_OUTPUT_BAUDRATE] [-p PACKET_SIZE] [--chunk-size CHUNK_SIZE] [--reconnect-delay RECONNECT_DELAY] [--fragment-delay FRAGMENT_DELAY] [--zero-df393 [MSG_ID ...]] [-v]

option.description: Read mixed UBX/RTCM input from this RTK base serial port instead of NTRIP
Do not forward RTCM messages to Ivy
Optional serial output receiving raw RTCM frames
Set the MSM DF393 multiple-message bit to 0 for these message IDs and recompute the RTCM CRC before forwarding (default: 1097; use --zero-df393 with no IDs to disable)
